sources.title: Meta's Twi TTS Model Lands on Modelers.cn - aichina.news
sources.snippet: A new open-weight TTS model for Twi (language code twe), derived from Meta's Massively Multilingual Speech (MMS) project, has been published on Modelers.cn, the Huawei/Ascend AI ecosystem platform. For developers working on Twi-language voice assistants, IVR systems, or accessibility tools, this is a welcome addition to a very sparse landscape.
